question.text: Nilgiri Multi-Strategy Fund is set up as an LVF for Accredited Investors under Cat III. By when must the LVF declare First Close, measured from the later of grant of registration or filing of PPM with SEBI?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI Circular SEBI/HO/AFD/RAC/CIR/2022/088 dated June 24, 2022, LVFs must declare First Close within 12 MONTHS from date of grant of registration of the AIF OR date of filing of PPM of scheme with SEBI, WHICHEVER IS LATER. The Trap: Options A and B are too tight. Option D is too long. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C/D test the LVF 12-month rule. XIX-E tests it as it affects Cat III LVF structuring timeline. Manager's Pro-Tip: Sequence registration and PPM filing deliberately — the clock starts from the LATER event. Delayed PPM filings extend your fund-raising window, useful for large mandates.
